title.en: Describe the organisation of a skeletal muscle
Identify the A band, I band, Z line, M line, H zone and sarcomere
Describe the structure of actin and myosin filaments

say.en: Under a microscope a skeletal muscle fibre looks like a barcode of light and dark bands. Those stripes are not decoration, they are the machinery of contraction. In this lesson: Describe the organisation of a skeletal muscle.
Identify the A band, I band, Z line, M line, H zone and sarcomere.
Describe the structure of actin and myosin filaments.

body.en: Each *skeletal muscle* is made of muscle bundles or fascicles held together by a collagenous connective tissue layer called fascia. Each bundle contains many muscle fibres. Each muscle fibre is lined by a plasma membrane called the sarcolemma, enclosing the sarcoplasm; the fibre is a syncytium because the sarcoplasm contains many nuclei. The endoplasmic reticulum of muscle fibres, the sarcoplasmic reticulum, stores calcium ions. The sarcoplasm contains many parallel myofibrils, which show alternate dark and light bands. The light band contains actin and is the I-band (isotropic); the dark band contains myosin and is the A-band (anisotropic).
body.kn: ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಫ್ಯಾಸಿಕಲ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಮಾಡಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದು ಫ್ಯಾಸಿಯಾ ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ನಾಯು ತಂತುವಿನ ಪೊರೆ ಸಾರ್ಕೋಲೆಮ್ಮಾ; ಸಾರ್ಕೋಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಿಕ್ ಜಾಲಿಕೆ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿ I-ಪಟ್ಟಿ (ಆಕ್ಟಿನ್), ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ A-ಪಟ್ಟಿ (ಮಯೋಸಿನ್).

narration.en: A sarcomere runs from one Z line to the next. Thick myosin filaments make the A band; thin actin filaments are fixed to the Z lines. When Ca²⁺ is released, myosin heads pull the actin towards the centre: the Z lines come closer, the I band and H zone shorten, but the A band keeps its length.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು Z ರೇಖೆಯಿಂದ ಮುಂದಿನದರವರೆಗೆ ಸಾರ್ಕೋಮಿಯರ್. ದಪ್ಪ ಮಯೋಸಿನ್ ತಂತುಗಳು A ಪಟ್ಟಿ; ತೆಳು ಆಕ್ಟಿನ್ ತಂತುಗಳು Z ರೇಖೆಗೆ ಅಂಟಿವೆ. Ca²⁺ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯಾದಾಗ ಮಯೋಸಿನ್ ತಲೆಗಳು ಆಕ್ಟಿನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರದತ್ತ ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ: Z ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ, I ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮತ್ತು H ವಲಯ ಕಿರಿದಾಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ A ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಉದ್ದ ಬದಲಾಗದು.

narration.en: The teacher zooms from a whole muscle to a sarcomere, labels the Z line, M line and bands, and sketches the actin and myosin filaments.

say.en: Zoom in step by step: a muscle is made of fascicles, each fascicle of muscle fibres, each fibre of myofibrils, and each myofibril of sarcomeres.
In a sarcomere, thin actin filaments are anchored to the Z lines and thick myosin filaments sit in the middle.
The I band has only thin filaments, the A band is the full length of the thick filaments, and the H zone is the middle part where thin filaments do not reach.
The thin filament is two F-actin strands twisted together, with tropomyosin and troponin. Troponin masks the myosin-binding sites at rest.
The thick filament is made of meromyosins. Each has a globular head with a short arm, the heavy meromyosin, and a tail, the light meromyosin. The head is an ATPase.

explanation.en: A sarcomere runs from one Z line to the next. Thin actin filaments are fixed to the Z lines; thick myosin filaments are held together at the M line. The A band is the length of the thick filaments, the I band holds only thin filaments, and the H zone is the middle of the A band where thin filaments do not reach.

say.en: A sarcomere is the unit of contraction. Name its bands and filaments.

body.en: The actin (thin) and myosin (thick) filaments lie parallel to each other and to the long axis of the myofibril. In the centre of each I-band is an elastic fibre, the Z line, which bisects it; the thin filaments are firmly attached to the Z line. The thick filaments in the A-band are held together in the middle by a thin fibrous membrane, the M line. The portion of the myofibril between two successive Z lines is the *sarcomere*, the functional unit of contraction. In a resting state, the edges of the thin filaments on either side of the thick filaments partially overlap the free ends of the thick filaments, leaving the central part of the thick filaments not overlapped: the H zone.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ಅನುಕ್ರಮ Z ರೇಖೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಾಗವೇ ಸಾರ್ಕೋಮಿಯರ್, ಸಂಕೋಚನದ ಕಾರ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಘಟಕ. Z ರೇಖೆ I-ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಇಬ್ಭಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; M ರೇಖೆ A-ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ತೆಳು ತಂತುಗಳು ಆವರಿಸದ ದಪ್ಪ ತಂತುಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗ H ವಲಯ.

points.en: Z line bisects the I-band; M line bisects the A-band
H zone: thick filaments not overlapped by thin filaments

say.en: The actin thin and myosin thick filaments lie parallel to each other and to the long axis of the myofibril. In the centre of each I-band is an elastic fibre, the Z line, which bisects it; the thin filaments are firmly attached to the Z line. The thick filaments in the A-band are held together in the middle by a thin fibrous membrane, the M line. The portion of the myofibril between two successive Z lines is the sarcomere, the functional unit of contraction. In a resting state, the edges of the thin filaments on either side of the thick filaments partially overlap the free ends of the thick filaments, leaving the central part of the thick filaments not overlapped: the H zone. Sarcomere equals Z line to Z line.

say.en: Z line bisects the I-band; M line bisects the A-band.
H zone: thick filaments not overlapped by thin filaments.

body.en: Each *actin* (thin) filament is made of two F (filamentous) actins helically wound around each other; each F-actin is a polymer of monomeric G (globular) actins. Two filaments of another protein, tropomyosin, run close to the F-actins along their length. A complex protein, troponin, is distributed at regular intervals on the tropomyosin; in the resting state a subunit of troponin masks the active binding sites for myosin on the actin filaments. Each myosin (thick) filament is a polymerised protein: many monomeric proteins called meromyosins form one thick filament. Each meromyosin has a globular head with a short arm (heavy meromyosin, HMM) and a tail (light meromyosin, LMM). The head and arm project outwards from the surface as the cross arm. The globular head is an active ATPase enzyme with binding sites for ATP and active sites for actin.
body.kn: ಆಕ್ಟಿನ್ ತಂತು ಎರಡು F-ಆಕ್ಟಿನ್‌ಗಳ ಸುರುಳಿ; ಪ್ರತಿ F-ಆಕ್ಟಿನ್ G-ಆಕ್ಟಿನ್‌ಗಳ ಬಹುಅಣು. ಟ್ರೋಪೋಮಯೋಸಿನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಟ್ರೋಪೋನಿನ್ ಇವೆ; ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರೋಪೋನಿನ್ ಮಯೋಸಿನ್ ಬಂಧಕ ತಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ಮರೆಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಯೋಸಿನ್ ತಂತು ಮೆರೋಮಯೋಸಿನ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಆಗಿದೆ; ಅದರ ತಲೆ ATPase ಕಿಣ್ವ.

points.en: Thick filament: meromyosins (HMM head + arm, LMM tail)
Myosin head = ATPase with ATP and *actin* binding sites

Each actin thin filament is made of two F filamentous actins helically wound around each other; each F-actin is a polymer of monomeric G globular actins. Two filaments of another protein, tropomyosin, run close to the F-actins along their length. A complex protein, troponin, is distributed at regular intervals on the tropomyosin; in the resting state a subunit of troponin masks the active binding sites for myosin on the actin filaments. Each myosin thick filament is a polymerised protein: many monomeric proteins called meromyosins form one thick filament. Each meromyosin has a globular head with a short arm (heavy meromyosin, HMM) and a tail (light meromyosin, LMM). The head and arm project outwards from the surface as the cross arm. The globular head is an active ATPase enzyme with binding sites for ATP and active sites for actin. Thin filament: F-actin plus tropomyosin plus troponin.

say.en: Thick filament: meromyosins (HMM head plus arm, LMM tail).
Myosin head equals ATPase with ATP and actin binding sites.

problem.en: In a relaxed sarcomere, the A-band is 1.6 µm, each half I-band is 0.5 µm and the H zone is 0.5 µm. Find the sarcomere length. Which of these lengths would stay the same when the muscle contracts?

steps.en: Sarcomere = half I-band + A-band + half I-band = 0.5 + 1.6 + 0.5 = 2.6 µm.
During contraction the thin filaments slide towards the centre of the A-band; the filaments themselves do not shorten.
So the A-band (length of the thick filaments) stays 1.6 µm, while the I-band and H zone shorten.

answer.en: Sarcomere = 2.6 µm; the A-band length stays constant
